sponsored post = a social-media message that a company has paid to promote
banner ad = a rectangular advert across a website
catalogue = a booklet or site listing goods you can order
leaflet = a folded sheet of paper with information or advertising
advertising campaign = a planned series of adverts for one product or cause
brand image = the idea people have of a company and its products
small print = the detailed conditions, often in tiny letters, at the bottom of a contract
free sample = a small amount of a product given away so you can try it
promotional offer = a special deal used to attract customers for a limited time
customer = a person who buys goods or services from a shop or company
refund = money you get back when you return goods or cancel a service
warranty = a written promise that a product will work for a stated period
faulty = not working correctly because of a defect
ombudsman = an official who investigates complaints against companies or services
after-sales service = help, repairs and advice after you have bought a product
return policy = the shop's rules about bringing goods back
money-back guarantee = a promise that you will get your money back if you are not satisfied
replacement = a new item given instead of one that is faulty or unsuitable
compensation = money paid because goods or a service caused loss or harm
cooling-off period = a set time after a sale when you may cancel without a penalty
